steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree (high school diploma, associate, or equivalent) and completion of required project management education hours. Notably, no prior work experience is needed—making CAPM ideal for Aurora professionals entering or transitioning into project management roles at any career stage.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of PM Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. This intensive format compresses training into a focused schedule, allowing you to master PMBOK® Guide fundamentals and exam domains without disrupting your work at Buckley Space Force Base, Anschutz Medical Campus, or elsewhere in Aurora.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the education requirement, apply directly to PMI and pay the exam fee. Granite PM Academy's team will guide you through the application process to ensure all documentation is complete and your eligibility is confirmed before exam registration.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the Exam
steps_items.text: Access Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions, study guides, and instructor support. Our live-virtual format keeps you on track with personalized feedback so you enter the proctored CAPM exam confident and ready to earn your credential.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM certification is valid for three years. Stay current by earning professional development units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteer work, or professional activities. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing learning options to help you renew and advance your project management expertise.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.

fq_items.question: Is CAPM certification worth pursuing for Aurora aerospace and defense careers?
fq_items.answer: Aurora's aerospace and defense sector—anchored by Buckley Space Force Base and major contracting firms—relies heavily on structured project governance and formal credentials. CAPM demonstrates foundational PM competency valued in base operations, systems integration, and defense-related capital projects. While not universally mandatory, it signals readiness for advancement into roles where PMP or equivalent certification becomes expected as you grow.

fq_items.question: Do Aurora hospital and school-district employers value CAPM certification?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Aurora's major healthcare systems (Anschutz Medical Campus, Children's Hospital Colorado, Kaiser Permanente) and school districts (Aurora Public Schools, Cherry Creek Schools) operate formal project offices managing construction, IT infrastructure, and clinical workflows. CAPM establishes credibility in these environments, especially for roles overseeing capital campaigns, EHR implementations, and facility upgrades where structured methodology is expected.

fq_items.question: Can Aurora professionals join live-virtual CAPM training from their workplace?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy's live-virtual CAPM course is designed for professionals nationwide to attend from any location with internet access—including your workplace, home, or library. Aurora-based professionals at Buckley, hospital systems, or school districts can participate without traveling, making it feasible to complete training while managing full-time project responsibilities.

fq_items.question: Should Aurora project managers pursue CAPM before or after landing a PM role?
fq_items.answer: Both paths work. Earning CAPM before job hunting strengthens your candidacy for entry-level PM roles at Aurora's healthcare, defense, and education employers—organizations that often prefer credentialed candidates. Alternatively, if you're already in operations or coordinator roles, CAPM accelerates your transition into formal project management and can support advancement within your current employer's project office.
